scientific_integrity: Proof uses a direct sign inequality, exact edge marginal, a Hall extension lemma and integer parity; finite exact checks corroborate rather than replace the all-order argument. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a sharp signed Fourier bound and complete first-zero layer for derangement matchings; it does not determine the full higher-weight nullspace, higher-weight absolute eigenvalue gaps or recovery projection norms. Archival priority is based on bounded full-text comparisons, not an exhaustive literature classification.
title: The sharp sparse Walsh-cancellation threshold for derangement matchings
